about: On the client's definition entity of a character creation, respec or change-appearance session: what the shown dummy is built from. Dummy names the client-only entity that is drawn; RootTemplate, Origin, Race, Subrace, BodyType, BodyShape, Classes fill the dummy's target visual when ChangeId moves, and Visual (the look: visuals, elements, colours) when ChangeId2 moves; the dummy keeps the last applied counters in ecl::character_creation::DummyComponent.

evidence.says: the component ClientCCDummyDefinition, engine name from Ext.Debug.GetComponentTypes

in SYS_CC_I two entities carry it (the character and the companion definition); the character's Dummy stands at 9.99 0.89 111.14 before the creation camera, while the server's player characters stand elsewhere and are not in the view
Script Extender exposes it as ClientCCDummyDefinition with the fields Dummy, Race, Subrace, BodyType, BodyShape, RootTemplate, Visual, ChangeId, ChangeId2

in SYS_CC_I, writing Race, RootTemplate and Visual and adding 1 to ChangeId redrew the dummy as the new race with the old look (the dummy's ClientCharacterCreationTargetVisual kept 3 Visuals); adding 1 to ChangeId2 then drew the 7 written Visuals and the skin colour

the per-frame dummy update (code:unplaced::ApplyDummyDefinitionChanges) compares the int at +0x8 with ecl::character_creation::DummyComponent.ChangeId and on a difference copies it and refills the target visual from +0x60, +0x70, +0x88, +0x80, +0x81; it compares the int at +0xC with DummyComponent.ChangeId2 and on a difference copies it and passes +0xC8 to the colours-and-materials fill

in a change-appearance session (Osi.StartChangeAppearance on the host) a client write of ChangeId2 + 1 is followed by the dummy's ClientCCDummy.ChangeId2 taking the same value and by exactly one call of the colours-and-materials fill (code:ecl::character_creation::SubsystemHelper::FillTargetVisualComponentColorsAndMaterials) from inside the update; ChangeId + 1 is followed by ClientCCDummy.ChangeId

a client write of +1 to the int at +0x10 (Script Extender: field_10) is followed by the dummy's ClientCCDummy.EquipmentChangeId taking the same value; the handle at +0x1A8 (Script Extender: field_1A8) names the client character being edited in a change-appearance session (it carries ClientCharacter, CCState, CharacterCreationAppearance)
Script Extender declares these fields for its component ClientCCDummyDefinition (Components/CharacterCreation.h); the offsets are the ones its legacy field names carry

in a change-appearance session Dummy names a client-only entity with ClientCCDummy, ClientCharacterCreationTargetVisual, ClientCharacterCreationCurrentVisual, Visual and Transform; RootTemplate, Race, BodyType and Identity read the edited character's values
